name: neximprove-onboarding
description: Customer onboarding workflow MVP - React + Express + PostgreSQL

scripts.//: Root scripts exist so a host (Render, Railway, Fly) can build and run the whole project with one command each.
scripts.//build: --include=dev is required: hosts set NODE_ENV=production, which makes npm skip devDependencies. vite and prisma live there and are both needed at build time.
scripts.build: npm install --include=dev --prefix backend && npm run db:deploy --prefix backend && npm install --include=dev --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix frontend
